gloss: to starve; to go hungry; to hunger for

definitions.gloss: to starve; to go hungry; to be famished
definitions.explanation: To suffer from a lack of food. Describes a state of serious hunger or starvation, not merely being peckish.

definitions.gloss: to hunger for; to crave; to thirst for
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, to strongly desire or crave something that is lacking, such as love, knowledge, stimulation, or recognition.

examples.japanese: {戦時中|せんじちゅう}、{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}が{飢|う}えた。
examples.english: During the war, many people starved.

examples.japanese: {飢|う}えた{子|こ}どもたちに{食料|しょくりょう}が{届|とど}けられた。
examples.english: Food was delivered to the starving children.

examples.japanese: {飢|う}えと{寒|さむ}さの{中|なか}で、{人々|ひとびと}は{必死|ひっし}に{生|い}き{延|の}びようとした。
examples.english: Amid starvation and cold, people desperately tried to survive.

examples.japanese: {愛情|あいじょう}に{飢|う}えている。
{新|あたら}しい{刺激|しげき}に{飢|う}えた{若者|わかもの}たちが{都会|とかい}に{集|あつ}まってくる。
examples.english: Young people hungry for new stimulation flock to the city.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{間|あいだ}{情報|じょうほう}に{飢|う}えていた{住民|じゅうみん}たちは、ようやくニュースを{手|て}に{入|い}れることができた。
examples.english: The residents, who had been starved of information for a long time, were finally able to get news.

notes:
USAGE:
{飢|う}える is an ichidan verb. The literal meaning (sense 1) describes serious hunger or starvation. The figurative meaning (sense 2) is very common and follows the pattern 〜に{飢|う}える (to hunger for ~).

The kanji can also be written as {餓|う}える, though {飢|う}える is more standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飢|う}えに{苦|くる}しむ (to suffer from hunger)
- {愛情|あいじょう}に{飢|う}える (to hunger for affection)
- {知識|ちしき}に{飢|う}える (to thirst for knowledge)
- {飢|う}えた{目|め} (hungry eyes)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飢|う}える: to starve (severe hunger; also figurative craving)
- {空腹|くうふく}: hunger (the state of having an empty stomach)
- {餓死|がし}する: to die of starvation (fatal outcome)
- {渇望|かつぼう}する: to yearn for (formal, figurative only)
